title: ChatVis: Automating Scientific Visualization with a Large Language Model
problem: Users struggle to generate correct Python scripts for scientific visualization and data analysis, requiring significant programming expertise. Script generation is tedious and error-prone, creating a barrier for domain scientists.
motivation: Automating visualization script generation from natural language enables domain scientists without deep programming expertise to create accurate visualizations, accelerating scientific data analysis.
method: ChatVis uses an LLM to generate Python scripts from natural language descriptions and implements an iterative refinement loop: scripts are executed, runtime errors are detected and extracted, and the LLM is prompted to correct errors based on these messages. This error-driven feedback cycle continues until the script executes correctly.
key_novelty: Iterative error detection and correction mechanism that leverages runtime error messages to guide LLM-based automatic script repair for scientific visualization.
contributions: ChatVis system enabling iterative LLM-based Python script generation from natural language specifications
Error detection and correction mechanism using runtime feedback to prompt LLM refinement
Demonstration of 100% success rate on canonical visualization scenarios versus 0% for unassisted LLMs

metrics.accuracy: 100% correct script execution on 5 canonical visualization scenarios; ChatVis succeeds where all unassisted LLMs fail
